title: Metric or Mirage?
instruction: Does this number track whether people are actually better off?

items.why: Clickbait wins on CTR and leaves people feeling deceived.

items.text: Share of users who come back on their own next week
items.why: Voluntary return is a better proxy for value than time spent.
Three hours of doom-scrolling scores high here.

items.text: Answers to 'Was this worth your time?' after watching
items.why: It asks about value, not behaviour.

items.text: Videos started, including ones abandoned after 3 seconds
Subscriptions still active after three months
items.why: Retention: people keep paying for what serves them.

items.text: How far people scroll in an infinite feed
items.why: A feed with no stopping point is not the same as a valuable one.

items.text: Saved items that are later actually used or bought

items.why: It measures how well the ping interrupts, not whether it helped.

debrief: Engagement measures behaviour; satisfaction measures value. Optimize the first alone and the number rises while the experience gets worse (Goodhart's law: a measure that becomes a target stops being a good measure).
